scope: Make persisted unresolved required questions actionable in the selected application: expose the exact question and unresolved reason, route it into per-job review without duplicates, preserve suggestion provenance and deliberate review, and add a separate confirmed Answer Bank save with profile version protection.

acceptance.unresolved_question_routing: PASS; the persisted preflight question, missing-answer reason and exact text are visible, and the deliberate review action carries that text into the selected application's answer form without a duplicate row.
acceptance.answer_review_and_provenance: PASS; existing exact-match method, score and source remain visible; edits clear per-job approval and require a fresh review before local export.
acceptance.confirmed_answer_bank_save: PASS; user selects a confidence and explicitly confirms accuracy and future reuse. The UI submits only supported profile fields with expected_version, replaces a matching normalized bank question using a new revision identity, and retains the concurrent-version conflict guard.
acceptance.sensitive_answers: PASS; sensitive/legal questions do not receive reusable suggestions or expose an Answer Bank action. A manually entered answer can proceed only through explicit per-job review and local export.
acceptance.durability_and_side_effects: PASS; the answer-bank entry and source/confidence read back after browser reload; reviewed answers export to application document history; synthetic acceptance observed no application attempts, state transition, confirmation or external network request.
acceptance.whole_requirement: PARTIAL; no external ATS session was exercised and the full example workflow including a separately named Continue action is not claimed complete. External submission was not attempted.

red_first_observation.details: The connected acceptance first found the persisted per-question missing-answer reason and actionable routing were absent from the application review screen.
